title: Priority basket: Positive proof strip
summary: Insert all readings into a binary min-heap and repeatedly remove the smallest. Produce that removal sequence, preserving duplicates. Return only the strictly positive values in the derived sequence, preserving their relative order and duplicates.
descriptionMd:
A heap-shaped basket keeps the smallest numbered service ticket ready at its opening. Rafi prepares a clean proof strip for the front desk. Positive derived readings keep their places relative to one another.

Insert all readings into a binary min-heap and repeatedly remove the smallest. Produce that removal sequence, preserving duplicates.

Return only the strictly positive values in the derived sequence, preserving their relative order and duplicates.

Implement priorityBasketPositiveProofStrip(readings, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.

referenceSolutions.python:
def priorityBasketPositiveProofStrip(readings, k):
    a=readings
    out=[]
    import heapq
    heap=a[:]
    heapq.heapify(heap)
    while heap: out.append(heapq.heappop(heap))
    return [x for x in out if x>0]
